name: Asparagus and Tarragon Velouté (Dairy-Free Creamy Asparagus Soup)

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for serving
fennel bulb, trimmed and thinly sliced
asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2–inch lengths
minced fresh tarragon leaves, plus more for serving

instructions.primary_message: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-low heat until shimmering. Add leek and fennel and a large pinch of salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until fully softened but not browned, about 5 minutes. Add flour and cook, stirring, until incorporated, about 30 seconds. Stir in stock and bring to a simmer.

Stir in asparagus and tarragon. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, remove a dozen asparagus tips from the pot, split them in half lengthwise, and set them aside for garnish. Continue simmering soup for 5 to 6 minutes longer. Stir in lemon juice.

Blend soup using a handheld immersion blender, or in batches using a countertop blender, until it's as smooth as you like. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper and serve, garnishing with reserved asparagus tips, crème fraîche (if using), more chopped tarragon, fennel fronds, and more extra-virgin olive oil.

schema_metadata.keywords: asparagus, easy, quick, soup, tarragon, veloute

description: An asparagus tarragon soup that's bright and vegetal with a velvety-smooth texture, despite containing no cream at all.
notes:
Optional or for serving: a few fennel fronds for garnish; Crème fraîche, for serving (optional)

Optional substitutions: low-sodium chicken stock → vegetable stock
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
